contexts.text: In the other life is most exquisitely perceived.
(The exquisite senses of Spirits.) AC 1521. AC 1881. AC 3726:end. AC 4527:2. AC 4622:2. AC 4622:3. AC 5078:4. AC 6054. HH 170. HH 462.
As perceptions are so exquisite... AC 1769:4.
The perception and sensation of good becomes by turns more exquisite.
Being internal and spiritual (the delight) is more pure and exquisite.
The marriage delight, which is a purer and more exquisite delight of touch...
All the senses... are then more exquisite than is possible when the body is awake.
